For the implementation, I'll compute iteratively using loops.

To compute a * b / g where g = gcd(a,b): I know that b = g * k, so k = b / g. I can find k by repeated subtraction: start with k=0, rem=b, while rem >= g: rem := rem - g; k := k + 1.

Let me structure this:

```t
t 1
gate loops
task smallest_multiple(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 1
  ensures r == lcm_upto(n)
spec fun gcds(a: int, b: int): int
  decreases a + b
= if a <= 0 then b else if b <= 0 then a else if a > b then gcds(a - b, b) else if b > a then gcds(a, b - a) else a
spec fun lcm2(a: int, b: int): int
  decreases a + b
= if a <= 0 then b else if b <= 0 then a else a * (b / gcds(a, b))
spec fun lcm_upto(n: int): int
  decreases n
= if n <= 1 then 1 else lcm2(lcm_upto(n - 1), n)
{
  r := 1;
  var i: int := 2;
  while i <= n
    invariant r == lcm_upto(i - 1)
    invariant i >= 2 and i <= n + 1
    decreases n - i + 1
  {
    var g: int := gcds(r, i);
    var k: int := 0;
    var rem: int := i;
    while rem >= g
      invariant rem >= 0
      invariant i == g * k + rem
      decreases rem
    {
      rem := rem - g;
      k := k + 1;
    }
    r := r * k;
    i := i + 1;
  }
}
```
